$schema-note: Every on-screen string of both apps. Generated into apps/ios/App/Localizable.xcstrings (+ App/Generated/Copy.swift) and apps/android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml by web/scripts/gen-mobile-copy.mjs. A value is a string, or an object: { text, args } for typed placeholders, { ios, android } for platform words, { count, one, other } for a plural (other names {count}). notPlural: true marks int placeholders that count no noun, so Android lint does not ask for a plural. {name} is a placeholder (a string unless args says int). Keys from design/specs/2026-10-30-mobile-apps.md section 13.
